title: BUENOS 05003: Argentina Media Carrying Stories, June 19, 1980
doc_notes: This document is a Department of State cable from the U.S. Embassy in Buenos Aires regarding media reports linking UFO sightings in Argentina to a NASA experiment called 'Firewheel'.

incidents.summary: Multiple UFO sightings reported across Argentina, speculated to be related to a NASA experiment called 'Firewheel'.
incidents.explanation: Speculated to be an artificial cloud created by a NASA experiment called 'Firewheel'.
incidents.quote: RECENTLY, THERE HAVE BEEN MANY REPORTS OF UFO SIGHTINGS HERE.

incidents.summary: Sightings of unidentified objects over Argentina on the Saturday prior to June 19, 1980.
incidents.explanation: Speculated to be the result of a NASA experiment called 'Firewheel'.
incidents.quote: THE UFOS THAT WERE SEEN OVER THE COUNTRY LAST SATURDAY
